Lust Runners – Epic Miniature Set

Unleash the fury of speed and desire with the Lust Runners – a complete set of 12 unique and dynamic miniatures, each sculpted with breathtaking detail and motion. Every model comes with carefully crafted pre-supported files, as well as the LYS option for expert users of Lychee, ensuring a smooth experience whether you’re a beginner or a veteran of the print battlefield.

Whether you march them into war or display them as collectors’ pieces, the Lust Runners are designed to command attention on any table. Fast, deadly, and impossible to ignore – they are the embodiment of passion turned into war.

This Hammerhead archer has you in his sights!


[Click here for Bullshark Warrior!](https://www.thingiverse.com/thing:4411931)


[Click here for the Greenland Mage!](https://www.thingiverse.com/thing:4411970)

This is 28mm scale miniature is ideal for tabletop role playing games such as D&D or Pathfinder. It is scaled to be printed as a -Large- miniature, which would fit on a 50.8mm diameter base. These sharks are big! If you attempt to print these as a medium sized creature, scale down to 50% (And take a picture, I'd love to see it!)

Feel free to glue a bit of string or fishing line or thin styrene in as a bow string :D

Included is a pre-supported Chitubox file that includes the Bullshark and Hammerhead for resin printing that has been tested and adjusted. Test printing was done on an Elegoo Mars in Elegoo Standard Gray at 7.7s / layer. I suggest running it through the Photon File Validator before printing!

[If you liked this model and want to show your thanks, you can buy me a coffee!](https://ko-fi.com/clayrade)

[And follow me on Instagram!](https://www.instagram.com/clay.rade/)

From the twisted forges of the abyss rises the Excess God’s Demonic Infantry 5.0—reborn for the fifth time in a relentless pursuit of perfection. Each model has been sculpted anew from the ground up, not just refined but completely reimagined, forged to embody the dark essence of excess and corruption.

Crafted exclusively for 10mm and 15mm scale, these warriors march with razor-sharp clarity: every horn, every blade, every shard of armor sculpted to strike the eye and dominate the battlefield. Their forms are designed not only for visual impact, but also for flawless, effortless printing, ensuring their terror manifests cleanly on your tabletop.

This is more than a unit—it is the culmination of years of refinement, the fifth evolution of demonic might, perfected for wargamers who demand nothing less than the extraordinary.

Set Includes:

Multiple dynamic demonic infantry poses (20)
Both supported and unsupported STL files
Precisely scaled for 10mm and 15mm warfare
Stand ready, for the legions of Excess march again.
